Sylvain has tousled red-orange hair and relaxed spear-student posture. Ashe has pale ash-gray hair, blue hooded layer, and bow. Annette is petite with peach-orange hair, straight bangs, curled side pigtails, nervous mage posture. Mercedes has blonde long side ponytail, white cravat, cream shawl trim, gentle healer presence, not matronly. Ingrid is blonde disciplined lance student with blue tights, checking the flank. Use formation roles and silhouettes rather than inventing generic uniformed students.
